'''Clawzor''' is a [[Water]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Cribbler]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Dreadclaw]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Living by the motto of 'just stay alive,' Clawzor eats little but grows plenty. Surviving in a world overrun with Zobos calls for a unique set of evolutionary rules, after all."

Clawzor is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A purple crab with a white underside and angry, red eyelids. Its pupils are purple, and it almost appears to be grinning. One of its claws is significantly larger than its body, similar to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiddler_crab fiddler crab]. The tips of its claws and legs are red, and its largest claw has an orange stripe after the red.

Clawzor's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with yellow.

== Evolution Trial ==
Clawzor's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Dreadclaw]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Clawzor to increase stats 3 times.
* Play Fishing Contest (use x2000 fishing rods) or Snowboard Sprint/Marathon Party (use x2000 boards).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Some say Clawzor's dad opened a burger place under the sea and hired an octopus & a sponge. Weird!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Clawzor had to grow bigger to balance body mass with the claw. Now crushes objects with the force of a hydraulic press."
